steps.note: From BackupScheduler.cs. The first check is 30 seconds after the service starts, then one every 5 minutes. An empty store is due at once, whatever the hour. Otherwise a backup is due once the hour (BACKUP_HOUR_UTC, default 1) has passed and today has no archive.

output: ops-1  |       The nightly backup is due but every database is empty (a stack waiting for a restore?); skipped.
steps.note: Logged when a backup is due but no database holds a table, view or sequence yet: a fresh stack waiting to be restored onto never gets an empty archive filed as the newest.

output: ops-1  |       Backup endgame-20261125T010312Z.egbk: 2 database(s) to the bucket 'endgame-backups' at 4b8e2d17c9a0f3e65d21b7c84a9f0e13.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, encrypted before upload
ops-1  |       Backup endgame-20261125T010312Z.egbk written: 51380224 bytes sealed in 9.1 s
ops-1  |       Backup endgame-20261117T010245Z.egbk pruned by retention
steps.note: The nightly run, then retention: it keeps the newest archive of each of the last 7 days and the last 4 ISO weeks, and always the newest. Pruning runs only after a backup succeeds. Ids, sizes, seconds and dates are illustrative.

output: ops-1  |       Backup failed: The S3 server answered 403 to PUT endgame/endgame-20261125T010312Z.egbk.
ops-1  |       The nightly backup failed; it will try again at the next check: The S3 server answered 403 to PUT endgame/endgame-20261125T010312Z.egbk.
steps.note: The failure is logged and retried at the next check, 5 minutes later. Nobody is notified: only this log and /health (its last attempt) carry it. The S3 error text is illustrative, and each line's exception is left out.

output: ops-1  |       The nightly backup schedule is switched off (Ops__Backup__ScheduleEnabled=false).
steps.note: With ENDGAME_BACKUP_SCHEDULE=false the timer stops at once. With a key that cannot be used it logs a warning instead: "No nightly backup will run:" and the reason.
